title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

I can't appeal this just because you claimed to be "lagging" 

Without proof this infraction will stay Valid.

Another reason that i'm denying your appeal is simply about your Date of Ban. You have only been banned for two months. 

Also i have just concluded that you have a second account that you are using to bypass this ban.

This means appealing will be extremely hard for you.
